headline: UK Energy Bills Set to Surge by 26% in January
summary: Energy bills will soar by 26% for millions of households in January following a surge in gas prices sparked by the Iran war.
why: Energy price caps and utility costs directly impact household disposable income and broader inflationary trends in the UK economy.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Higher energy bills reflect surging gas prices impacting household costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
